```sh
kafka group offsets <groupId>
```

Show a consumer group's committed offsets

## Arguments

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `groupId` | group id    |

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../../global-options/).

## Defaults

Reads committed offsets without committing resolved offsets. With no --topic filter, reads every topic with offsets for this group.

## Flags

| Flag                            | Description                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--brokers <string>`            | comma-separated broker list, e.g. localhost:9092                                               |
| `--topic <string> (repeatable)` | limit the result to this topic (repeatable; defaults to every topic the group has offsets for) |

## Examples

```sh
kafka group offsets my-group --brokers localhost:9092
kafka group offsets my-group --topic orders
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
[
  {
    "topic": "events",
    "partitions": [
      {
        "partition": 0,
        "offset": "42",
        "metadata": null
      }
    ]
  }
]
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `1`, `2`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
